name: Tobias Dietl
headline: Customer Success Manager & Agile Team Lead für Mobile App Projekte
summary: IT-Projektleiter und Team Coach mit umfassender Expertise in der Leitung und als Facilitator für agile, digitale Projekte. Ich unterstütze mittelständische und große Unternehmen in den Bereichen Energie, Technologie, Versorgung, Versicherungen und Mobilität, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf München, Deutschland und die DACH-Region. Mein Ziel ist es, durch innovative Apps und IT-Lösungen maximalen Mehrwert zu schaffen und als Customer Success Manager unsere Kunden auf ihrem Weg zum Digital Champion zu begleiten.

company.name: iteratec
company.description:
With more than 1,000 successful projects, iteratec is one of the leading experts for digital product innovation, software and architecture development, and digital infrastructures. 

As an end-to-end partner for the digital transformation in the private and public sector, we take the technological lead for our customers in mastering complex challenges related to the digitisation of their processes, products and services. This ranges from the joint development of digital innovations and the technical implementation of customer-specific software solutions to DevOps and performance management as well as digital empowerment of organisations through training and agile methods. 

We create measurable results by creating extraordinary user experiences through innovative mobile applications, by creating resilient processes with the help of highly flexible cloud architectures or by optimising the performance of complex application landscapes through the introduction of comprehensive application performance management - and we shape future viability for tomorrow by tapping the potential of ground breaking technologies such as Blockchain, AI, or IoT by jointly developing disruptive business models for our customers.

In this way, we open up new technological and entrepreneurial opportunities and develop our customers into digital champions. They include leading medium-sized companies as well as DAX-listed corporations from a wide range of

industries such as automotive, eCommerce and energy, financial services, industry and logistics, media and the public sector. 

Founded in 1996, iteratec currently employs around 500 employees and 100 students at seven locations in Germany, Austria and Poland. Since 2019, a large part of the workforce has held shares in iteratec GmbH via a cooperative.
